user.title: Connect to Scaleway AI
user.description: Enter your Scaleway credentials. You can generate an API secret key in the Scaleway console under IAM → API Keys. The key needs the *Generative APIs* permission.

data_description.api_key: Your Scaleway API secret key. Starts with 'scw-' or is a UUID.
data_description.project_id: Scaleway project ID to scope calls to a specific project. Leave blank to use your default project.
data_description.base_url: OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Leave the default for serverless Generative APIs. Set to your Managed Inference URL (e.g. https://{deployment-uuid}.ifr.fr-par.scaleway.com/v1) to use a dedicated deployment.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Scaleway AI
reauth_confirm.description: Your Scaleway API key is no longer accepted. Enter a new secret key.

abort.entry_not_loaded: Cannot add a conversation agent while the Scaleway AI integration is disabled or unloaded.

init.title: Conversation agent
init.description: Give this assistant a name and decide how it should behave.

data_description.prompt: Instructions the LLM will follow. This is a Jinja2 template with access to Home Assistant state (areas, exposed entities, current time, …).
data_description.llm_hass_api: Which Home Assistant LLM APIs the agent may call. Leave empty for a pure chat agent that can't control anything.

model.title: Model & generation parameters
model.description: Pick a Scaleway model and tune generation parameters. Sensible defaults are pre-filled.

data_description.chat_model: Any Scaleway Generative APIs chat model. The list is fetched live from your account; you can also type a model ID manually.
data_description.temperature: Higher = more creative, lower = more deterministic. Typical range 0.2–1.0.
data_description.top_p: Nucleus sampling cutoff. Usually leave at 1.0 unless you know you want it lower.
data_description.max_tokens: Maximum length of the assistant response, in tokens.
